item.title: Long Island MBA program rankings and tuition costs compared
item.description: Stony Brook University leads Long Island‘s MBA programs with 530 students enrolled in 2024, operating from Nicolls Road in Stony Brook. Andrea Goldsmith serves as president. The program offers part-time […]

item.title: Warby Parker opens fourth Long Island store
item.description: Warby Parker is opening a new Holbrook store at the Shops at SunVet, joining other Long Island locations as the redeveloped center adds new tenants.

item.title: LI restaurants gear up for Valentine’s Day
item.description: Long Island restaurants prepare special menus, cocktails and brunches as couples celebrate Valentine’s Day this weekend.

item.title: Long Island commercial real estate deal volume sets new record
item.description: Commercial real estate sales on Long Island surged to a record $4.1B in 2025, led by specialty use assets and rising investor activity, per Cushman & Wakefield.

item.title: How arts therapy supports mental wellness for Long Island children and adults
item.description: Arts therapy programs on Long Island help children and adults express emotions and improve mental wellness through creative workshops and exhibitions.

item.title: On Our Island: Jake’s 58 and Maple Family Centers support kidney health and veterans on Long Island
item.description: Jake’s 58 Casino Hotel raised over $11K for the National Kidney Foundation, while Maple Family Centers donated more than $1 million to veterans' programs on Long Island.

item.title: Cantor: Long Island consumer sentiment drops amid rising household debt in 2025
item.description: Long Island's consumer sentiment fell to its lowest since 2023 amid rising household debt and financial stress, impacting local economic outlook in 2025.

item.title: Cona: How estate planning ensures lasting love and family harmony this Valentine’s Day
item.description: Estate planning, including wills and trusts, protects your family's future and supports lasting love by preventing conflicts and ensuring your wishes are honored.

item.title: Inked: Long Island commercial real estate sales and leases in Great Neck, Bethpage, and Bay Shore
item.description: The Balterman family and Pervez Kahn made key commercial real estate transactions in Great Neck and Bethpage, including sales and industrial leases across Long Island.

item.title: Foreigner musical debuts at LIU’s Tilles Center
item.description: 'Feels Like the First Time – The Foreigner Musical' premieres at LIU’s Tilles Center April 17-26, directed by Adam Pascal and featuring classic hits.
